title: Replace doctor's per-memory full-text integrity probes with a read-only table check
outcome: Replace doctor's per-memory full-text integrity probes with a read-only table check
acceptance: Doctor verifies the object_fts index with a read-only check whose work is bounded by index size rather than one full-text MATCH for each memory head; per-row content binding and orphan checks remain, and corruption is still reported.
The change is measured on a memory-heavy store and covered by a corruption regression test, accounting for the existing unicode61 tokenizer/query mismatch tracked separately.

completion.summary: Landed 401b92d (bundle 5B): doctor verifies object_fts with one content pass that binds each memory head (changed, repeated, missing and orphan rows named) plus SQLite's read-only integrity_check of the table. The per-head unindexed lookup and MATCH are gone. Corruption is still reported (structure and postings vs text), and operational errors propagate. Measured at 9000 memory heads: 34.3 s old vs 14.2 ms new.
